prompt: Implement batch_key(value). Require a string of exactly three nonempty components separated by colon. Strip surrounding whitespace on each component, case-fold the first and second, leave the third case-sensitive. Whitespace inside a stripped component is invalid. Return a tuple. Raise ValueError on any invalid input.

Implement status_tally(events). Each event is (ticket, sequence, status). ticket is a nonempty string, sequence is a positive plain integer excluding bool, and status is 'open' or 'closed'. Return a dict with both keys open and closed, counting each ticket once at its greatest sequence. Identical duplicate records are allowed. Conflicting statuses for any equal ticket and sequence raise ValueError even if that sequence is stale. Raise ValueError on invalid fields.

Implement clip_spans(spans, low, high). Intersect each half-open interval (start, end) with the half-open range [low, high). All bounds must be plain ints, with start <= end and low <= high, otherwise raise ValueError. Validate every interval even if the target range is empty. Drop empty intersections, preserve input order, and return a new list of tuples. Do not merge or mutate.
